title: With nested CALCULATE the outer filter is in place when the inner filter argument is evaluated
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], FILTER ( VALUES ( Customer[Country] ), [Sales Amount] > 250 ) ), 'Date'[Year] = 2023 ) )

source.quote: In these functions, the first parameter is evaluated only after all the others have been evaluated.
source.supports: the outer CALCULATE's first parameter, the inner CALCULATE, is evaluated only after the outer filter has been applied

source.quote: the outer filter over Italy is executed first and it applies its effects to the FILTER function
source.supports: the outer filter applies its effects to a FILTER evaluated inside the outer CALCULATE's expression

derivation: The inner CALCULATE runs in the context Year = 2023. There FILTER finds US 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 = 210, JP BLANK (Cho's sales are in 2024), FR BLANK: none exceeds 250. The country filter is empty, so the result is BLANK.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: the only value is BLANK.
